files.changeSummary: Nexus internal Electron debugger adapter with shared owned/borrowed lease cleanup, active/current-authority checks and dropped post-detach data. No upstream adapter code copied and no registered transport or product endpoint.

Only the scoped internal CDP factory references upstream preview access; exact frozen scope/entry/window/WC session/document/profile and abort/current-authority guard revoke internal leases. Personal and locked review profiles refuse. Production anonymous preview bridge/transport removed; remaining browser manager is Nexus-authored. F-1326: emulated-viewport capture cut by a smaller pane is flagged truncated with the captured size. Disk hygiene: loaded partitions are tracked so the sweep never deletes a live Chromium profile, and HTTP caches can be cleared under disk pressure (Nexus-authored). 20/10: o navegador do agente julga a página por padrão depois de navigate, click, fill e press, com orçamento de ~1,5 s. Review 22/10/2026: agent input goes through webContents.sendInputEvent with a trusted-event probe and a synthetic fallback; actions settle on request quiescence instead of a fixed 150 ms; agent-owned panes get disableDialogs; history navigation (back/forward/reload); full-page and themed screenshots borrow the debugger briefly; the Jev text tie-break uses pickBrowserFindElement with the order check; a full-page capture cut on either side is marked truncated and fullPage with an element ref is refused. All Nexus-authored.
